verdict.rationale: Serverless usage-based pricing is a fair question for a vector database, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents self-hosted deployment modes (Lite, Standalone, Distributed on Kubernetes) and contains no serverless tier or per-unit pricing. A passing community mention of a separate Zilliz SaaS gives no pricing details and is not this product's documented capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
